title: South Cambridgeshire - Contact centre chatbot to improve resident satisfaction
summary: South Cambridgeshire reports lower call volumes after chatbot rollout and better call classification, without numerical savings or satisfaction results.
account: South Cambridgeshire deployed EBI chatbot and call-routing functions to handle routine queries. The council reports fewer calls than in the prior year during the chatbot's first three months and better call classification/routing. No numerical call-volume reduction is supplied. The 93% accuracy figure is a council test result, not independently verified service correctness. Call-volume comparisons do not isolate causality.
purpose: Resolve routine queries and route contacts so that staff can focus on more complex needs.
system: EBI.AI chatbot, live chat, AI interactive voice response, and planned voicebot functions

ratings.reason: The council reports reduced routine-call demand and better routing, supporting modest operational efficiency.
Officers receive more calls on the correct topics, reducing routine friction. Improved resident satisfaction is an aim rather than a reported result.

ai_role.statement: The deployed chatbot and routing functions answer or classify routine contacts. The council reports fewer calls and better routing, but year-on-year comparisons do not isolate causality and no resident-satisfaction result is supplied.

evidence.citation: Council or project account published in the Local Government Association AI case-study bank. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: South Cambridgeshire - Contact centre chatbot to improve resident satisfaction

produced_by: The model was configured with council website and policy material, predefined flows, and staff testing.
The rollout included chatbot, live chat, and interactive voice response, with further integrations planned.
must_hold: The conditions needed to reproduce the benefit are unspecified.
